questions.question: When you have free time, what do you enjoy most?

options.text: Building or fixing things with my hands
Drawing, designing, or creating something visual
Reading, researching, or learning about how things work
Organizing events or helping friends solve problems

questions.question: Which school subject do you find most interesting?

options.text: Math or computer science
Biology or chemistry
Art, music, or creative writing
Shop class, engineering, or anything hands-on

questions.question: How do you feel about working with people every day?

options.text: I love it — I'm at my best around people
I like teamwork but also need solo time to focus
I prefer working independently or in small groups
It depends on the project — I'm flexible

questions.question: What kind of problem would you most enjoy solving?

options.text: A patient isn't feeling well and nobody knows why
A website keeps crashing and needs to be fixed
A building's electrical system needs to be redesigned
A company needs a new brand identity to attract customers

questions.question: What matters most to you in a future career?

options.text: Making a direct impact on people's lives
Creative freedom and self-expression
Financial stability and growth potential
Job security and being able to work anywhere

questions.question: Imagine your ideal workday. Where are you?

options.text: In a hospital, clinic, or lab helping people
At a desk with a computer, building something digital
On a job site, outdoors, or in a workshop
In a studio, agency, or creative workspace

questions.question: How do you feel about going to college?

options.text: I'm excited — I want to dive deep into a subject
I'd rather learn by doing — apprenticeships or on-the-job training
I'll go if it helps my career, but I want practical skills
I want a mix — some school, some real-world experience

questions.question: Which of these would you binge-watch?

options.text: A medical drama like Grey's Anatomy
A tech documentary like The Social Dilemma
A competition show like Shark Tank
A home renovation show like Fixer Upper

Technology.label: Technology
Technology.description: You think in systems and love building things that work. Careers in tech let you create, innovate, and solve problems at scale.

Medicine.label: Medicine & Healthcare
Medicine.description: You care deeply about people and want to make a tangible difference in their lives. Healthcare careers put you on the front lines of human well-being.

Trades.label: Skilled Trades
Trades.description: You're hands-on, practical, and love seeing the direct results of your work. The trades offer strong pay, independence, and careers that can't be outsourced.

Arts.label: Arts & Design
Arts.description: You see the world through a creative lens and want your work to inspire, communicate, or delight. Creative careers turn your vision into impact.

Business.label: Business & Finance
Business.description: You're strategic, organized, and energized by growth. Business careers let you drive decisions, manage resources, and shape how organizations succeed.

Science.label: Science & Research
Science.description: You're curious, methodical, and driven to understand how things work. Science careers let you explore, discover, and push the boundaries of knowledge.
